component.name: Nothing X; Nothing Ears
component.summary: Unofficial Linux companion for Nothing / CMF earbuds

description.p: EarA brings the missing Nothing X / Nothing Ears desktop experience to Linux: battery (left, right, case), ANC, EQ, gestures, find-my, and ear-tip fit test.
GTK4 / libadwaita GUI plus CLI. Uses BlueZ RFCOMM — the same protocol family as community Ear (web). Tested with Nothing Ear (a); other Nothing and CMF models are best-effort.
EarA — неофіційний Linux-компаньйон для навушників Nothing / CMF: батарея, ANC, EQ, жести, find-my та тест амбушюр.
Independent community project — not affiliated with Nothing Technology or CMF. Product names are trademarks of their owners.
